input_contract.description: The backend must construct these 17 post-feature-engineering inputs before calling either exported pipeline (regression or classification). Identical feature contract to the prior XGB_03 export - unchanged.
input_contract.missing_value_expectations: Numeric features may legitimately be missing near sequence starts or around packet-loss gaps (history-dependent engineered features); the pipeline's internal median imputer (fitted on Development only) handles this. Categorical features must not be missing - OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore') handles only previously-unseen category VALUES, not missing/null entries.
input_contract.note: Batch_ID/Timestamp may be needed by the backend to construct temporal context, but they are not passed as physical model predictors unless they appear through an explicitly engineered selected feature.
input_contract.temporal_feature_construction_requiremen: CRITICAL DEPLOYMENT NOTE: neither the regression pipeline nor the classification pipeline performs Stage-07 temporal feature engineering (exact-timestamp lags, Temperature_Rate_per_10min/Humidity_Rate_per_10min, *_Change_30m/60m, *_RollStd_30m/60m). The backend MUST construct these 7 engineered numeric features from historical sensor readings, using the EXACT same definitions as src/07_feature_engineering.py, before calling either pipeline. Do NOT claim the serialized estimators perform this history-dependent feature engineering themselves - they do not.

preprocessing_inside_pipeline.fit_scope: Fitted on Development (Train+Validation, 20,405 rows) only - identical recipe/scope to the prior XGB_03 export.

regression_output.status: UNCHANGED - not touched during classification finalization
regression_output.postprocessing_note: Do not silently alter research evaluation outputs. For runtime UI safety, a separate service-layer rule may clamp impossible negative displayed time to zero if explicitly documented.

classification_output.model_name: Ordinal XGBoost Classifier with Argmax Decision Rule
classification_output.architecture: Two cumulative binary XGBoost estimators (O1: P(Y>=Warning), O2: P(Y>=Critical)) + deterministic monotonicity correction + probability reconstruction + argmax decision rule. This is NOT a single ordinary multiclass estimator.
classification_output.load_instructions: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '<path to backend/app/ml/component_3_smokehouse>'); import ordinal_fire_risk_pipeline; import joblib; model = joblib.load('fire_risk_pipeline.pkl'). The module must be imported BEFORE joblib.load() so the pickled class can be resolved.

predict_proba_contract.row_sum_guarantee: Each row sums to 1 within numerical tolerance (verified <= 1e-6 on all 20,405 Development rows; observed max 1.19e-07).

predict_contract.decision_rule: argmax(predict_proba(X)) - no hidden thresholding, no probability override
predict_contract.note_vs_prior_xgb03_contract: XGB_03's predict() returned an integer class id (0/1/2). The Ordinal pipeline's predict() returns STRING labels directly; use predict_int(X) for the equivalent 0/1/2 integer encoding used throughout the research pipeline (Stage 20-33, classification_v2).

development_groupkfold_evidence.methodology: 5-fold GroupKFold by Batch_ID, Development (Train+Validation) only, Test never loaded

classification_output.safety_limitation: Critical-class generalization remains limited and batch-sensitive: 2 of 6 Critical-containing development batches produced zero Critical Recall under every method tested across two rounds of controlled experimentation. This classifier is a research/prototype decision-support model and must NOT be treated as a certified fire alarm, guaranteed fire detector, or production safety device. A separate domain-validated physical safety backstop may be appropriate in the future but is NOT part of this ML artifact.
classification_output.historical_note: The prior classifier (XGBoost XGB_03) and its Stage-31 locked-test evaluation (Warning Recall 0.986, Critical Recall 0.0) remain preserved, unmodified, as historical evidence at backend/app/ml/component_3_smokehouse/archive/. That Stage-31 evaluation was NOT rerun for the Ordinal classifier because the Test set has already been observed historically and cannot be presented as an untouched independent test for a newly promoted model. The Ordinal classifier's promotion decision is based entirely on development-only GroupKFold evidence.
